endorsements.quote: Solutions must integrate seamlessly with existing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and clinical workflows.

Multi-center studies will be needed to validate these tools across diverse healthcare settings with particular emphasis on establishing appropriate clinical thresholds and understanding potential confounding factors.
AI-based screening tools must be validated across diverse racial, ethnic, linguistic, and socioeconomic populations to ensure equitable performance and avoid bias.

unlisted_practices: Develop AI screening tools with representative datasets and transparent reporting of limitations.
Design new screening tools to avoid creating additional documentation burden for clinicians.
Adapt AI screening tools to the specific constraints and objectives of each care setting.
Provide training programs and intuitive interfaces for AI tools that account for varying technological expertise and high staff turnover.
Establish clear evidence of sensitivity, specificity, and clinical utility for new AI screening approaches before adoption.
Treat generative AI for care planning as exploratory and not as a replacement for clinician judgement.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary based on stakeholder interviews discussing implementation pathways, barriers, and strategies for AI-driven cognitive screening and digital biomarkers.
